abstract: OBJECTIVE: To date, epidemiological evidence has consistently supported a link between ovarian cancer risk and menopause. However, little is known about how menopause status affects the risk of specific histological subtypes of ovarian tumors. We aimed to analyze the differences in various histopathological subtypes of ovarian tumors between pre- and postmenopausal women. METHODS: We reviewed the medical records of women who underwent surgery for ovarian tumors and received histopathological confirmation at the Busan Paik Hospital between January 1997 and October 2016. Pathological findings were regrouped according to 2014 World Health Organization (WHO) classification and subdivided into the following five main categories: epithelial, germ cell, sex cord-stromal, tumor-like lesions, and secondary tumors. RESULTS: A total of 4,683 cases (3,404 premenopausal and 1,279 postmenopausal) were included in this study. Among the 4,683 neoplasms, epithelial tumors accounted for 52.6%, germ cell tumors for 27.1%, sex cord-stromal tumors (SCSTs) for 4.1%, tumor-like lesions for 14.0%, and secondary tumors for 0.8%. Among the epithelial tumors, malignant epithelial tumors were significantly associated with postmenopausal women (5.4% vs 22.1%, P < 0.0001), whereas benign epithelial tumors were significantly associated with premenopausal women (40.5% vs 31.9%, P < 0.0001). Among the 1,271 cases of germ cell tumors, most (97.6%) were benign mature teratoma and 2.4% were malignant germ cell tumors. Germ cell tumors were noted more frequently in premenopausal women than in postmenopausal women (31.3% vs 16.1%, P < 0.0001). Among the 194 cases of SCSTs, fibrothecoma was the most common (71.6%) followed by adult granulosa cell tumor (12.9%). The majority of SCSTs occurred in postmenopausal women (2.1% vs 9.5%, P < 0.0001). Among the 656 cases of tumor-like ovarian lesions, corpus luteum cyst was the most common (31.9%) followed by tubo-ovarian abscess (27.6%). Tumor-like ovarian lesions were significantly associated with premenopausal women (15.2% vs 10.7%, P = 0.0001). Among the 36 cases of secondary tumors, 66.7% of the metastatic ovarian tumors were Krukenberg tumors. There was no significant difference in the incidence of secondary tumors between the groups. CONCLUSIONS: We demonstrated the differences in diverse histological subtypes of ovarian tumors according to the menopause status based on the new WHO classification for Korean women.
abstract_ja: 目的:疫学的証拠は、卵巣癌のリスクと閉経との関連を一貫して支持してきた。しかし、閉経状態が特定の組織型の卵巣腫瘍のリスクにどのように影響するかはほとんど分かっていない。閉経前後の女性における卵巣腫瘍の各組織型の違いを解析することを目的とした。方法:1997年1月から2016年10月までに釜山ペク病院で卵巣腫瘍の手術を受け、組織学的に確定診断された女性の診療記録をレビューした。病理所見は2014年の世界保健機関(WHO)分類に従って再分類し、上皮性、胚細胞性、性索間質性、腫瘍様病変、続発性腫瘍の5大カテゴリーに細分した。結果:4,683例(閉経前3,404例、閉経後1,279例)が本研究に含まれた。4,683腫瘍のうち、上皮性腫瘍は52.6%、胚細胞腫瘍は27.1%、性索間質性腫瘍(SCST)は4.1%、腫瘍様病変は14.0%、続発性腫瘍は0.8%を占めた。上皮性腫瘍のうち、悪性上皮性腫瘍は閉経後女性と有意に関連していた(5.4%対22.1%、P<0.0001)一方、良性上皮性腫瘍は閉経前女性と有意に関連していた(40.5%対31.9%、P<0.0001)。胚細胞腫瘍1,271例のうち、大部分(97.6%)は良性の成熟奇形腫で、2.4%は悪性胚細胞腫瘍であった。胚細胞腫瘍は閉経後女性より閉経前女性に多くみられた(31.3%対16.1%、P<0.0001)。SCST 194例のうち、線維莢膜細胞腫が最も多く(71.6%)、次いで成人顆粒膜細胞腫(12.9%)であった。SCSTの大部分は閉経後女性に発生していた(2.1%対9.5%、P<0.0001)。腫瘍様卵巣病変656例のうち、黄体囊胞が最も多く(31.9%)、次いで卵管卵巣膿瘍(27.6%)であった。腫瘍様卵巣病変は閉経前女性と有意に関連していた(15.2%対10.7%、P=0.0001)。続発性腫瘍36例のうち、転移性卵巣腫瘍の66.7%はKrukenberg腫瘍であった。両群間で続発性腫瘍の発生率に有意差はなかった。結論:2014年の新しいWHO分類に基づき、韓国人女性において閉経状態により卵巣腫瘍の多様な組織型に違いがあることを示した。
